task_intent: Refine five Tessera music, conversation and arcade games with expressive native boards and matching wall compositions.
mobbin_query: A tennis match scoreboard with two opposing players and a court

mobbin.observed: A football field occupies the main image. Two opposing team marks and large scores sit together below it, with a small Final status between them and action controls beneath.
mobbin.applied: Give the court an uninterrupted geometric stage; place opposing scores in a separate top band and ready/serve/paused/final labels beneath the scores. Keep all phone controls outside the playable rectangle.

mobbin.observed: An opposed-driver comparison uses orange and teal halves with separate names and numbers; the shared comparison remains visually centred between the competitors.
mobbin.applied: Use restrained mint and blue identities for the left and right paddles and scores, with explicit LEFT/RIGHT player names so colour is never the only cue.

mobbin.observed: A dark tennis match list separates opponent names, event names and court metadata using a restrained text hierarchy.
mobbin.applied: Keep rally length, target score and point feedback subordinate to the court and primary paddle controls.

primary_web.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines — Game controls
primary_web.applied: Offer direct dragging on the court plus visible Up/Down buttons, a native height slider and VoiceOver adjustable control. Keep controls outside gameplay, at least 44 points high, with press feedback and a compact largest-text layout.

primary_web.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines — Gestures
primary_web.applied: Make touch the immediate default; keep tilt optional because motion and posture cannot be required of every player. Direct touch takes over from tilt immediately.

primary_web.title: Apple Developer Documentation — CMMotionManager
primary_web.applied: Use the app's sole motion manager at a controlled update interval. Calibrate the current attitude and paddle position over twelve samples, smooth small changes and guard queued callbacks with a session token.

primary_web.title: Apple Developer Documentation — Device-motion updates
primary_web.applied: Stop device-motion updates on disable, background, navigation, connection loss, player change and match completion. Do not automatically restart tilt when a screen or connection returns.

primary_web.title: Box2D — Simulation
primary_web.applied: Use a fixed 120Hz accumulator and sweep to each first contact within a step, then integrate the remaining time after reflection. Include the ball's full radius at paddles and court edges, bound rally speed and pause after a long frame delay instead of skipping unseen physics. No Box2D dependency was added.

assets: Original SwiftUI Canvas court and production Python RGB renderer share normalized geometry and palette. No third-party images are shipped as application assets.

validation.scope: Root integration owns native builds, simulator interactions and captures, wall and iPhone deployment, and physical panel review. Software RGB renders do not certify LED colour.
